sections.h2: India already grows both vegetables ajvar needs at industrial scale

chart.title: West Bengal alone grows nearly a quarter of India's eggplant
chart.source: Figures as stated in the article.

sections.means: India produces roughly 12.6–12.8 million tonnes of eggplant a year from over 760,000 hectares.
sections.todo: Site a first plant near a leading eggplant state so that the supply chain stays short.

sections.h2: Serbia sends India very little back, so the import channel stays small

chart.title: India sent Serbia €403.3 million against €21.9 million the other way
chart.source: Figures as stated in the article.

sections.means: Serbia's exports to India were €21.9 million in 2025, so imported ajvar can only ever be a small trade.
sections.todo: Build for the domestic shelf rather than the specialty import trade, which caps volume at this scale.

sections.h2: Karnataka supplies a sizeable share of India's capsicum, one state among many

chart.title: Karnataka grows 43.02 kilotonnes of capsicum, 6.9 per cent of India's total
chart.source: Figures as stated in the article.

sections.means: Capsicum is grown across many states, so no single region is needed to supply a plant.
